US Gas and Diesel Prices Reach Near-Record Highs

The national average for regular gasoline in the U.S. reached approximately $4.46 per gallon, nearing its year's high of $4.56 recorded on May 21. Diesel prices are also nearing $6 per gallon in nearly all 50 states, with Texas and Oklahoma being exceptions. These record diesel prices are impacting farmers and may lead to increased food prices.
